aboutText: Based in Collingwood, Real Good Wood has been supplying Melbourne's finest FSC-certified sustainable hardwood for over 15 years. We source directly from responsibly managed forests across Victoria, ensuring every plank meets the highest quality and environmental standards. Our team combines traditional milling expertise with modern processing to deliver timber that is honest from forest to home. Whether you are a builder, carpenter, or home renovator, we are the trusted choice for reliable, sustainable timber supply.

aboutImages.alt: Raw timber logs ready for processing

servicesText: At Real Good Wood we offer a complete range of timber services from sustainable sourcing to custom milling and processing. Our Collingwood facility handles everything in-house, including our innovative charcoal production line that turns offcuts into premium products. We are committed to zero-waste practices and delivering exceptional timber solutions across Melbourne.

services.title: Sustainable Hardwood Supply
services.desc: We supply a comprehensive range of FSC-certified hardwoods sourced from responsibly managed forests across Victoria and beyond.

services.title: Charcoal Production
services.desc: Our innovative production process transforms sawdust and offcuts into premium-grade barbecue and industrial charcoal products.

services.title: Timber Milling & Processing
services.desc: Our state-of-the-art Collingwood facility mills raw logs into precision-cut timber to your exact specifications.

services.title: Custom Timber Cutting
services.desc: From unique dimensions to special profiles, our custom cutting service delivers timber tailored to your project requirements.

services.title: FSC Certification & Sourcing
services.desc: Every timber product we supply comes with full FSC chain-of-custody certification for complete peace of mind.

services.title: Sawdust & Offcut Recycling
services.desc: We minimise waste by converting all sawdust and offcuts into useful products like charcoal and animal bedding.
